name: braille-qr
description: Generate dense text-rendered QR codes as terminal text, self-contained HTML, or a browser app.
author: Kitty Crow (https://kittycrow.dev)

scripts.preview: bun run src/main.ts --html && bun run src/serve.ts --open
scripts.site:check: bunx tsc -p site/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p site/tsconfig.bun.json --noEmit
scripts.site:ci: bun run version:check && bun run check && bun run site:check && bun run site:build && bun run site:test
